descriptionChirho: The ancient Canaanite city of Shechem (modern Nablus), situated in the hill country of Ephraim between Mount Gerizim and Mount Ebal, an important cultic and political center throughout Israelite history (Gen 12:6; Josh 20:7; Judg 9; 1 Kgs 12:1).

A masculine proper name borne by (a) the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the region around the city of Shechem who violated Dinah (Gen 33:19; 34:2–26), and (b) a descendant of Manasseh through Gilead, eponymous ancestor of the Shechemite clan (Num 26:31; Josh 17:2).
